about.title: About SplitSmart
about.appDescription: SplitSmart is a tool for organizing and splitting shared expenses in a practical and secure way. All information is stored locally on your device (or in the browser on the web version), with no internet connection or online account required.
about.feature1: ✅ Complete management of events and shared expenses
about.feature3: 💰 Multiple splits: equal, by amount, by percentage
about.feature5: ⚡ Smart startup and sample data to get started quickly
about.feature6: 🔐 Data stored locally — no external servers of our own
about.platform: Platform: React Native + Expo 52 (iOS, Android, Web)
about.madeWith: Independently developed with ❤️ in Córdoba, Argentina
about.privacyItem1Desc: We do not send any information to servers
about.privacyItem2Desc: You decide what data to keep and for how long
about.privacyItem4Desc: Take your data whenever you want
about.devTeamDesc: SplitSmart is developed with passion by a team dedicated to creating simple, secure, and effective financial tools for everyday life. Our commitment is to keep your privacy as the top priority while offering the best possible experience.

The application does NOT constitute financial, accounting, or legal advice. Results are for guidance only and the user is solely responsible for verifying amounts and agreeing on payments with other participants.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introductionText: This Privacy Policy describes how SplitSmart, an independently developed application, handles user information. Using the application implies acceptance of this policy. This document complies with Argentine Law No. 25,326 on Personal Data Protection.
privacy.dataCollectionText:
SplitSmart only processes information you enter directly:
• Profile data (name, email, phone — optional fields)
• Events, expenses, and participants you register
• Local preferences and settings

Note: Google Play Store may independently collect technical device data according to its own privacy policies.
privacy.dataUseText:
Data you enter is used exclusively to:
• Display and calculate expense splits
• Maintain your event history
• Store your configuration preferences

No personal data is sent to our own servers or used for commercial, advertising, or analytics purposes.
privacy.dataStorageText: All data is stored in the local SQLite database on your device. The app requires no internet connection or online account to function. You can delete all your data from Settings → "Delete All Data", or by uninstalling the application.
privacy.dataSharingText: SplitSmart does not transmit, sell, or share personal data with third parties. The app does not access contacts, location, or microphone. Camera access is optional and only for receipt photos, with your explicit permission. Google Play Store operates independently and is governed by its own privacy policy.
privacy.dataSecurityText: Since no data is transmitted over the internet, the risk of unauthorized remote access is minimal. Data security depends primarily on your device protection measures (screen lock, encryption, system updates). We recommend not sharing your device without an active lock.
privacy.userRightsText:
In accordance with Argentine Law No. 25,326 and its amendments, you have the right to:
• Access: view your stored data at any time
• Rectification: modify inaccurate or incomplete data
• Deletion: permanently delete your data
• Confidentiality: your data will not be shared with third parties

These rights can be exercised directly within the application or by contacting the developer.
privacy.contactText: For questions about this policy or to exercise your rights under Law 25,326, you can contact the developer through the "Contact Support" section of the application.
